categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in two primary business segments: (1) CTP (Computer to Plate) equipment manufacturing, including thermal and UV flexographic CTP systems for printing plate production, and (2) 3D printing equipment manufacturing, including sand mold 3D printers, metal 3D printing heads, and ceramic 3D printers. The company also manufactures inkjet print heads and provides related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include 256-channel laser modulation technology for high-precision printing, piezoelectric inkjet printing head technology with multiple proprietary designs, high-precision motion control systems using linear motors and servo drives, and 3D sand mold printing technology using inkjet methods. Manufacturing methods include precision mechanical assembly, laser processing, and automated production lines for print heads and printing equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include printing companies in the flexographic and offset printing sectors, foundries using 3D sand mold printing technology, and manufacturers in the 3C electronics, shoe mold, and precision casting industries. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international markets across 60+ countries including Korea, India, Indonesia, Brazil, Russia, Vietnam, Thailand, and various European nations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Guangzhou and manufacturing facilities in Hangzhou. International operations span over 60 countries and regions including Asia (Korea, India, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, Myanmar, Singapore, Japan), Europe (Italy, Bulgaria, Belgium), Americas (Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Costa Rica), Africa (Egypt, Nigeria, Ethiopia), and the Middle East (UAE, Oman, Qatar). Domestic sales are distributed across all Chinese provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a midstream to downstream manufacturer, producing specialized industrial printing equipment and components. It manufactures core components (print heads, laser heads) and integrates them into complete printing systems for end-use customers. The company also participates in downstream services through 3D sand mold printing service centers established as joint ventures.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) expanding high-end CTP product market share through 256-channel laser technology; (2) scaling 3D sand mold printing equipment production and services; (3) developing 3D metal printing heads for 100% domestic production; (4) expanding print head product lines including MEMS technology, display industry, and circuit board applications; (5) developing ceramic 3D printing through partnerships with Japanese companies; (6) advancing automation and Industry 4.0 capabilities in manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through: (1) direct sales of CTP equipment to printing companies via both direct sales and distributor channels; (2) sales of 3D printing equipment to foundries and manufacturers; (3) sales of print heads to equipment manufacturers; (4) annual maintenance service contracts (year-protection services); (5) equipment rental and leasing; (6) equipment upgrade services; (7) 3D sand mold printing services through joint venture printing centers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the CTP market, the company competes with international manufacturers and maintains a leading domestic market position with advanced 256-channel laser technology. In 3D printing, the company is positioned as a growing competitor with proprietary sand mold printing technology. The company emphasizes technological differentiation through domestic innovation and cost advantages. Key competitive advantages include independent R&D capabilities, comprehensive product lines, and established distribution networks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company generated 1.90 billion yuan in revenue in 2024, representing 19.27% growth from 1.59 billion yuan in 2023. However, the company reported a net loss of 30.35 million yuan in 2024 compared to 60.36 million yuan loss in 2023, showing improvement. Total assets reached 5.90 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company is in a growth phase with expanding 3D printing business offsetting mature CTP market pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) proprietary 256-channel laser modulation technology enabling higher precision and speed than competitors; (2) comprehensive 3D printing solutions including sand mold, metal, and ceramic printing with 100% domestic component sourcing; (3) advanced print head technology with multiple proprietary designs reducing import dependence; (4) integrated solutions combining equipment sales with service center operations; (5) focus on automation and Industry 4.0 compatibility; (6) cost advantages through domestic manufacturing and component integration.
